title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.58: Ancient cards. Standing Ovation - the Ancient form of High Note (transcend it at the Orobas node): deal 4/6 damage 3x, gain 6/10 Vigor, Swap 2/3 & Invert 2/3 simultaneously. One Take is now an Ancient power (granted by Darv's Dusty Tome).
